exposure: COVID-19 pandemic restrictions (no visitation or touch)
outcome: postnatal bonding (measured using the Postpartum Bonding Questionnaire)
maternal anxiety (measured using the Beck Anxiety Inventory)
postpartum depression (measured using the Edinburgh Postpartum Depression Scale)
adjustment disorder (measured using the Adjustment Disorder-New Module 8)
cohort: The study included mothers of newborns admitted to a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit in Turkey during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Low gestational week, low birth weight, increased maternal age, maternal anxiety, high postpartum depression scores, and hospitalization negatively affected maternal bonding.
gest_age: not specified, but study mentions "low gestational week"
